children: Hong Kong property developer's half-year revenue fell sharply from prior year
Company posted significantly bigger net loss attributable to shareholders for the period
Gross loss reported for the half-year, compared to gross profit last year
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods
REVENUE DECLINE - Co's half-year revenue fell 66% as recognised GFA (Gross Floor Area) from delivered properties dropped 57% to 223,686 sq.m.
GROSS LOSS - Co reported gross loss for the period, reversing gross profit from previous year as the property-market downturn cut margin to -24% from 10%
